title: Post-candidate-014 source-repair external-process landing-readiness confirmation
question: На exact candidate-015 закрыты ли пять независимо обнаруженных candidate-014 source gaps, сохраняет ли внешний Luna max актор корректный handoff к отдельному reviewer и остаётся ли незаландившийся SDK CI pin честной отдельной dependency-обязанностью при observe-only usage без execution ceilings?

protocol.wake_policy: A schema-valid writer result activates a separately prepared reviewer; completed work does not wake the parent by itself, and only an observed unresolved authority condition may request parent-level re-entry.

immutable_invariants: One read-only role contract, objective, rubric, validation command set, observe-only metering policy, effect ceiling, stop-lines, and transition apply to every writer arm.
The packet has execution_limit_policy=none and cannot turn observed tokens, time, turns, output, commands, or cost into a runtime stop.
The packet cannot authorize owner acceptance, model-fit admission, commit, push, PR, merge, release, publication, service mutation, secret access, or global configuration mutation.
All arms inspect Git HEAD 4a7d6212011a3a01c61ffdd6f91f38b8faa9cfea and the same exact bytes for all 58 status entries and 106 content entries.
Any HEAD, status, binary diff, path-kind, size, symlink target, changed/untracked content digest, study packet, or metering-policy drift invalidates preparation or launch.

metrics: evidence precision, anchor validity, and reproducibility
runtime status, active wall time, turns, input, cached-input, and output tokens
output bytes, executed commands, and failed helper commands
useful findings per measured active wall second and token

result_refs.notes: Luna max confirmed all five candidate-014 source repairs and all eleven fixed validations, preserved the exact final workspace manifest, and correctly retained the old published aoa-sdk CI pin as the only blocking residual. It used 5,185,000 input, 4,883,968 cached-input, and 31,742 output tokens over 871.020999 active seconds.

The first independent Luna max reviewer reached the right logical return_for_repair conclusion but failed runtime admission after citing one shortened noncanonical source path. The runtime refused A2A export and preserved the failure. It consumed 6,236,054 input, 5,987,328 cached-input, and 40,358 output tokens over 945.483850 active seconds.

A fresh distinct Luna max reviewer used canonical source paths, reran all eleven validations, confirmed all local repairs, and independently returned for repair on the remote aoa-sdk CI pin. It used 3,826,852 input, 3,608,064 cached-input, and 30,060 output tokens over 737.127942 active seconds.

The successful reviewed A2A return binds the exact writer and retry-reviewer threads/results/reports/workspace manifests. It explicitly returns responsibility as failed/return_for_repair and makes no acceptance or fit claim.

Observe-only aggregate includes the writer, failed reviewer, and successful retry: 15,247,906 input, 14,479,360 cached-input, 102,160 output tokens, 2,553.632791 active seconds, 218 commands, and no execution budget.
Schema-valid aoa-summon external_cli_reviewed receipt references the task-local obligation/mandate/DAG, exact SDK/runtime artifacts and usage, and returns both named outputs without accepting them.

attribution_limits: The packaged aoa-sdk A2A contour is a typed C2 transport carrier, not an admitted landing owner contour; runtime results remain transport evidence.
This is one exact dirty abyss-stack worktree and one landing-readiness task instance, not a randomized task suite or a general model ranking.
The active economics are ChatGPT quota; token use and current reference prices do not establish realized USD cost.
No study-authored execution budget exists. Provider context/quota limits and explicit operator interruption are external observations and must not be reinterpreted as model-chosen stop-lines.

Runtime, prompt, role, tools, context, repository familiarity, trial order, caching, quota state, and model behavior can all contribute to differences; model identity alone is not a causal conclusion.

A reviewer prepared from each writer currently reuses that writer's exact realization. Session and context separation is real, but same-realization review bias remains and aoa-evals may require another review modality.

Candidate-014 remains counterevidence: its Sol writer and separate Luna reviewer found five complementary source gaps while both Luna writers missed the Sol set; its reviewed A2A return is return_for_repair, not accepted proof.

The GitHub workflow still pins an older published aoa-sdk commit because the new SDK ABI has no addressable landed commit yet. Local source proof uses the exact SDK worktree; remote CI readiness requires SDK-first landing and a later exact pin update.
Schema-valid completion, process identity, green validators, or one accepted reviewer decision do not by themselves prove net benefit or an admitted Luna scope.
